name: Breadcrumb
description: A Wishing Well standard-issue E.L.F. Deposits Φ1-5 into Q-zero wallets from untraceable sources. The deposits are too small to flag, too irregular to predict.
observed_behavior: Scans for wallets with zero or near-zero balance and inserts micro-deposits sourced from transaction rounding errors across the network.
story_hooks: A Q-zero resident tracks the deposits and realizes they always arrive on the day they most need them — coincidence or awareness?
